note: Her brain lane config — single source of truth for which provider/model each brain lane maps to. The brain-switch script (scripts/brain-switch.mjs) reads this to point Samantha's live .pi/settings.json at a Her-controlled provider instead of the borrowed claude-bridge. Lanes are the ONLY thing Her code/config should reference; the concrete provider/model behind a lane can change here without touching consumers. envKey names only — real key values live in the environment (.env / setx), never here.

brain-main.note: 日常大脑。DeepSeek v4-pro,DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 已在环境,工具透传实测通过。这是 claude-bridge 的默认替代。

brain-bulk.note: 批处理/低成本车道(消化道类)。v4-flash 更便宜。

brain-kimi.note: Kimi Code 大脑候选。等 MOONSHOT_API_KEY 进环境后即可切;pi 内置 kimi-coding provider。

brain-glm.note: 智谱 GLM 大脑候选。等 GLM_API_KEY 进环境后可切;pi 内置 zai provider。

claude-bridge.note: 原借用大脑(借 Fei 的 Claude 订阅,keyless)。Fei 有 Claude 访问权时可回切;CLAUDE_BRIDGE_SUBSCRIPTION 是哨兵值,永不解析成真 key。
